description: Manages the various types of documents used within the system, categorized by the entity they relate to.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of document types, optionally filtered by the entity they belong to, with pagination and sorting capabilities.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to filter document types by (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project').

pageIndex.description: The 0-based index of the page to retrieve.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

orderBy.description: The field name to sort the results by.

ascending.description: Determines the sort order: true for ascending, false for descending.

example_uses: How can I get all document types for 'Partner' entities?
List all available document types, showing 20 per page.
Retrieve document types for 'Project' entities, sorted by name in ascending order.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch a list of document types, either for a specific entity or all document types, with options for pagination and sorting.
